user.title: Connect to HikConnect
user.description: Enter your HikConnect (Niko Smart Home) account credentials and the serial number of your access control doorbell.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to HikConnect. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Check your username and password.

init.title: Local device access (two-way audio)
init.description: Enter the local IP address and credentials of your doorbell to enable the announce service (TTS through the doorbell speaker). Leave empty to disable.

error.cannot_connect_local: Could not connect to the doorbell at the given IP. Check the IP address and credentials.
